notes.title: New Quality of Life update
notes.notes:
Hello!

Extortion will be 4 years old next week !

I've been working on some quality of life fixes today to change my mind from working on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2146380/Manufactur_inc/]Manufactur'inc[/url] demo, my factory management game.

Lots of things we talked about in the Steam Forum, on Discord and in early october IRL convention (my first one!).

Changes:
[list]
[*] #1822 - Handle ~ and $PWD when navigating in folders / opening files
[*] Fix save delete image on small screens
[*] #1823 - When restoring a save it sometimes miss informations
[*] #1820 - SCP should handle multiple arguments and download them all
[*] #1775 - You are not able to go in the parent directory of "/" anymore
[*] #1773 - Autocompletion doesn't work with clearLogs command
[*] #1660 - User shouldn't be able to type while commands are running
[*] #1659 - When a user doesn't exist, passwordBruteForce shouldn't reply "Password found: ?" but an error
[*] #1658 - Fullscreen/Windowed modes
[*] #649 - Copy/Paste (select then CTRL + C to copy, CTRL + V to paste)
[*] [u]Developer side:[/u] Update lots of technical dependencies
[/list]

I hope you'll enjoy this update and the game :)
Have a good day!

Elanis

notes.title: Price update following Steam Recommandation
notes.notes:
Hello !

As you can see on Steam right now, recommanded prices have been updated by Valve for developers.

Immediatly with theses recommanded prices, I adjusted price of both Dysnomia games to keep the same euro price.

What does that mean ?

Most prices will fluctuate between -15% and +20%:
- US Dollar prices lowered by 17% to 4.99$ (-1$)
- British pound prices lowered by 11% to 4.29£ (-0.5£)
- Canadian dollar prices lowered by 3% to 6.49$ (-0.2$)
- Russian ruble increased by 29% to 200₽ (+46₽)
And so on

You can see price variations on SteamDb by selecting your currency: https://steamdb.info/app/1299430/

Have fun !
Elanis

notes.title: 1st birthday update !
notes.notes:
Hello !

Yesterday was the 1st birthday of Extortion Release. I worked a bit during the last weeks to make a small update and improve game architecture to make next updates easier.

There will be still updates, you can follow next update(s) roadmap at: https://bugs.dysnomia.studio/projects/hacking-game/roadmap

Have fun !

----

Full changelog:

Improvements:
 - #1104, #1106 - Improved French texts (better wording, fix typos)
 - #1106 - Improved English texts (better wording, fix typos)
 - Improved game files support for new languages
 - #946 - Added more automated tests to the game (especially around autocompletion)
 - Updated technical dependancies to improve performances & safety
 - Improved console design
 - Improved text contrast

Added:
 - #1023 - Narrator message when firewall goes to 0
 - #1238 - Added update automation to make me easily update the game
